title: Avoid foreign key default name join format allocation
description: Replace default foreign key name construction via child_columns.join("_") and format! with a preallocated string builder.

criteria: Default foreign key name construction no longer allocates an intermediate joined child-column string
Generated default foreign key name bytes remain unchanged for multi-column child keys
Explicit foreign key names remain cloned unchanged

notes: The default name path now computes the exact required child-column component length and appends into a single String.
Foreign key metadata storage keys and constraint validation logic are unchanged.
